brief: The 6 anti-aging habits actually backed by science.

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.subtitle: SIX HABITS BACKED BY REAL SCIENCE

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.title: WEAR SPF DAILY
slots.body: Sunscreen is the single most effective anti-aging product available. Daily broad-spectrum SPF prevents collagen breakdown and dark spots. Think of it as your non-negotiable morning ritual.

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.title: PRIORITIZE SLEEP
slots.body: Your skin repairs itself while you rest, making sleep essential for regeneration. Aim for seven to nine hours to support collagen production and reduce inflammation. A consistent bedtime is the ultimate luxury.

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.title: USE RETINOIDS
slots.body: Retinoids are the gold standard for stimulating cell turnover. They smooth fine lines, even skin tone, and boost elasticity over time. Start low and slow to build tolerance gracefully.

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.title: STAY HYDRATED
slots.body: Plump skin begins from within, so drink water consistently throughout the day. Combine internal hydration with a barrier-supporting moisturizer to lock in moisture. Dewy skin is simply well-hydrated skin.

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.title: MANAGE STRESS
slots.body: Chronic stress elevates cortisol, which accelerates aging and impairs healing. Gentle rituals like breathwork or facial massage help regulate these hormones. Calm mind, calm complexion.

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.title: EAT ANTIOXIDANTS
slots.body: A diet rich in colorful fruits and vegetables fights free radical damage. Vitamins C and E protect skin from oxidative stress and support a natural glow. Nourishment is visible on your face.

slots.author: DR. ELENA VOSS
slots.headline: START TODAY
slots.body: Consistency transforms these habits into visible, lasting results. Begin your science-backed journey to radiant skin now.
